Priya Shah: FYI — Evan Brooks submitted his resignation today. Last day set to 2025-05-09. Can we lock in exit tasks?
Samir Patel: Thanks — I'll start IT offboarding checklist. @Hannah can you confirm any privileged access to revoke?
Hannah Gomez: Got it. Evan has access to GitHub org (admin on infra-repo), GCP project redwood-prod, Okta, Slack and Datadog. I’ll schedule key revocations for last business hour of 05/09.
Priya Shah: COBRA/bene timeline: benefits active through 05/31/2025, COBRA notice window 60 days. PeopleOps will send the COBRA packet by EOD tomorrow.
Evan Brooks: confirming I received the offline acceptance and my last day is 2025-05-09. Happy to do an exit interview — Priya, what times work?
Priya Shah: Thanks Evan. Can you do 5/07 at 2pm PT? If not, suggest a couple windows. Exit interview will be with me + anonymized summary in 1:1s.
Evan Brooks: 5/07 2pm PT works. Also I still have my company laptop and monitor — do you want me to ship or drop off?
Samir Patel: Drop-off option: our SF office accepts returns M-F 10-3, use code "EVAN-RET-23" at the front desk. Ship option: we can email a pre-paid label. Tell me preferred address.
PeopleOps-Bot: Reminder queued — send COBRA packet to evan.brooks@redwood.com on 2025-04-30.
Hannah Gomez: Re: keys — I'll run `./revoke_keys --user evan.brooks --services github,gcp,datadog,slack` in the final hour. Also will rotate infra deploy keys on 05/10.
IT-Bot: Automated ticket created: IT-6790 (hardware return) assigned to Samir Patel. Link: https://tickets.redwood.com/IT-6790
Priya Shah: Samir/Hannah — please confirm when each item is done. I'll post a final checklist for HR tasks (final paycheck, COBRA mailed, benefits end) and mark complete.
Samir Patel: Will do. I’ll update IT-6790 when label sent and when hardware received.
Hannah Gomez: Adding one note: Evan was on two SSO groups that have scheduled CRON jobs. I'll check with infra to ensure no orphaned processes.
Evan Brooks: Thanks team. Appreciate the smooth handoff. Happy to help with docs this week.
Priya Shah: Thanks Evan — appreciate it. Everyone, tagging this as the canonical thread for offboarding actions. :white_check_mark:
